info.title: Integrated Strategy System API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code` and a translatable `messageKey`.

AccessMeDto.description: What the signed-in user can open and do; the UI uses it to show menus and actions (the server still checks).

ActInput.description: A decision on a task (API body).

AdminHealthCheck.description:
One check on the administrator Health page. Never English text: MessageKey and Params are translated by
the client (namespace `health`). Params values are invariant strings (numbers, ISO 8601 dates, codes); never secrets.

AdminHealthItem.description: A line inside a check (e.g. one scheduled job, one module's migrations). Labels are AR / EN where the item has a name.

AdminHealthReport.description: The Health page (ADR 0151): overall status (worst of all checks), when it was checked and every check.

AiDataSharing.description: What may be sent to the provider: per system and fields, documents, and masking of personal data.

AiFeatureSettings.description: Per feature: switch, provider and model (else the default provider and its default model).

AiFormField.description: A form field the AI may propose a value for.

AiLimits.description: Monthly limits (null = none), counted in the installation's time zone.

AiOcrSettings.description:
Text recognition (OCR) for scanned PDF pages and images (ADR 0033): off by default; Tesseract language codes joined by `+`; at most
`MaxPages` scanned pages per document.

AiProviderInput.description: A provider to save. `ApiKey` null keeps the stored key; `ClearApiKey` removes it.

AiProviderProbeInput.description: Values to try before saving (all optional: the stored ones are used).

AiSettings.description: Settings → AI (docs/design/ai.md §3). Master switch off on a new installation: everything works without AI.

AiSettingsDto.description: Settings → AI. `OcrAvailable`: Tesseract and the configured languages are installed on the server (ADR 0033).

AntiforgeryToken.description: The token the SPA sends back in string AntiforgerySetup.HeaderName on every state-changing call.

ApprovalSettings.description: Settings → Approvals: which organisation levels the "section manager" and "department director" rules look for (ADR 0025).

ApprovalStatusView.description: The pending step of a record as the current user sees it (for current-status providers).

ApprovalStepDefinition.description: One step of a chain, as configured in the Approval Settings centre.

ApproverBriefDto.description: An approver brief: the AI paragraph and points (drafts), plus the changes computed from the audit trail (facts).

ApproverRule.description:
Who approves a step. Only the parameters of string ApproverRule.Kind are used: `role` → string? ApproverRule.RoleKey; `sectionManager`,
`departmentDirector` → string? ApproverRule.Of; `headOfUnit` → Guid? ApproverRule.UnitId or string? ApproverRule.Of; `owningUnit` →
string? ApproverRule.SystemCode (default: the process's system); `employee` → Guid? ApproverRule.EmployeeId; `recordRole` / `teamRole`
→ string? ApproverRule.RoleCode.

AuditEntryDto.description: An entry as shown on History tabs and the Audit Log.

AuditFindingUpsertInput.description: PUT by external ID (ADR 0165): `ReportId` and `Recommendations` are used when the finding is created, ignored on update.

BaselineItem.description: One item of a baseline snapshot (milestone or epic).

BilingualText.description: A value in both languages (status message parameters).

BoardConfig.description: A project's board (configurable columns, WIP limits, swimlanes — SPEC §1.13).

BrandingSettings.description: Branding per installation (SPEC §0.2): names, colour, email header / footer. Logos are separate assets.

BusinessHoursReference.description: A business-hours record as other components see it.

CapActionProgress.description: An action as a source system shows it (live, read-only).

CapSourceProgress.description:
Live progress of a source (ADR 0123). bool CapSourceProgress.AllActionsCompleted: at least one completed action, every remark final and every
approved action completed — completion requires evidence, so this means "completed with evidence".

CardValues.description: Everything an author sets on a card (form / API / AI builder).

ChangeApplyValues.description: What the PM confirms in "Apply changes" (pre-filled from the request; only the fields of the type are used).

ChecklistItem.description: A verification checklist item (SPEC K4.3, ADR 0064).

ContributorDto.description: A contributor as the API shows it: the Emirates ID is masked for everyone (reveal is a separate, audited call — ADR 0086).

CreatedAccessTokenDto.description: The new token: string CreatedAccessTokenDto.Token is shown once and never stored.

CreateTask.description:
New Task (SPEC §11.7): one or many assignees (and / or every employee of a unit) → one task per assignee, tied by an assignment group
when there are several (SPEC §11.4).

CriterionLevel.description: One level of a team criterion. `Min` / `Max`: data range for a data-backed criterion (Min inclusive, Max inclusive; null = open).

CriterionResult.description: The evaluator's choice for one criterion, with the system's suggestion and its basis.

CurrentStatus.description:
"Next action required + who" (SPEC §0.2) for one record: a translatable message with parameters, who acts, and the actions the
current user may take now.

CurrentStatusAction.description: A next action offered on the current-status banner (code handled by the record page).

CustomApprovalAction.description: A labelled extra button, e.g. "Approve with conditions" (outcome approve).

DataElement.description: A data element of a composite KPI (e.g. numerator / denominator).

DemoPackLoadInput.description: Request body of `POST /setup/demo-pack`: the password the demo users sign in with.

DemoPackStatusDto.description: State of the demo pack: per contributor, the number of records it created that are not removed.

DemoPackStepDto.description: Outcome of one contributor in a demo pack run.

DiffEntry.description: One field the PM changed before accepting a vendor value.

DiffPart.description: A run of the comparison: `same`, `added` or `removed` text.

numberCode.description: Value of `{TYPE}` in the Document ID.

ackRequired.description: Read acknowledgement required by default on publish.

DocTypeRule.description: Validity and behaviour of a document type (ADR 0084, 0087).

DocumentBadge.description: A document as another system may show it (only when the user may see it — sensitivity clearance, ADR 0083).

EffectivenessLevel.description: A control effectiveness level; decimal EffectivenessLevel.Factor is the formula variable `C` (0–10).

EmployeeRefDto.description: A short reference to an employee shown next to units, managers and delegations.

EnrolmentResultDto.description: Result of a completed MFA enrolment: signed in, plus the recovery codes to show once.

EvaluationStatusDto.description: An evaluation as a person without the results permission sees it: status only.

ExtractedFieldDto.description:
One proposed value: never saved by the server; the review UI shows it as a draft (docs/design/ai.md §4.1). Where the source was found:
`LocationKind``page` / `slide` / `image` with its number, and `FromScan` when the text came from OCR (ADR 0033).

FieldCondition.description: Condition on another field of the same form (visibility / required).

FieldError.description: A validation failure on one field.

FilesSettings.description: Settings → Files: global upload limit and the optional ClamAV scan (SPEC §0.2 "size / type limits, virus-scan hook").

FindingExtractionDto.description: Draft findings — nothing is saved until the Audit Office confirms the rows it keeps (ADR 0134).

system.description: Defined in code by the owning module: the builder cannot remove or retype it.

targetType.description: Linkable type of string FieldTypes.Record fields (Links registry).

multiple.description: File fields: more than one file.

accept.description: File fields: allowed kinds (`pdf`, …); empty = any document kind.

titleOf.description: `ar` / `en`: the value is the request's title in that language.

requestUnit.description: A unit field whose value is the request's unit (approver resolution).

FormField.description: One field of a form, mini-form or table (column).

FormFillDto.description: Values proposed by AI for the wizard: drafts only, never saved by the server (CLAUDE.md rule 6).

FormSchema.description: A form: sections of fields (request form, approve form or action mini-form).

GateChecklists.description: Configurable stage-gate checklists (SPEC §1.12), in addition to the hard minimums. Seeded items are optional; an organisation marks the ones it requires.

GateItem.description: A gate item as the record page shows it (live checklist).

ImportIssue.description: One problem found in an uploaded file. int ImportIssue.Row is the sheet row number; string? ImportIssue.Column a column key.

missedIncludesAmber.description: Publish `KpiTargetMissed` for amber results too (red always).

KpiYearPerformance.description: Year-to-date performance of a card's annual plan (approved results only).

LinksToDto.description: Links pointing at a record: the visible ones resolved, the others only counted.

LinkView.description: A resolved link as the UI shows it. Only string LinkVisibility.Visible views carry content.

McpSettings.description: Settings → MCP (docs/design/mcp.md §4). The server is off on a new installation.

McpToolSettings.description: Per tool: null keeps the tool's default (read on, write and approve off).

MeasuringMethodRule.description: A Measuring Method code mapped to its aggregation rule (SPEC K5).

MilestoneProgressValues.description: A milestone progress update as the PM enters it in the monthly window (ADR 0071).

MyWorkCardItem.description: One item on a card (deep link to the record).

MyWorkCount.description: A counter on a My Work card. Tone: neutral, info, success, warning or danger.

MyWorkItem.description: An item that needs the user's action, shown on My Work.

NewFindingInput.description: A recommendation entered together with its finding (form, import, AI confirmation).

OrgTreeNodeDto.description: A node of the organisation tree (flat list; the client builds the tree from Guid? OrgTreeNodeDto.ParentId).

PagedResultOfAiUsageRowDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfAuditEntryDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfAuditFindingListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfAuditReportListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfAuthEventDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfBenchBestPracticeDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfBenchComparatorDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfBenchStudyListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfCapActionListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfCapRemarkListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfCapSourceListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfCapSuggestionDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfDeliveryDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfDocumentListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfEmployeeListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfIpListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfKpiCardListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfProjectListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfRequestListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfRequestRowDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfRiskListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfSampleItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfTaskListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfTeamListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfUserDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PdfTemplate.description: A bilingual HTML template with merge fields (ADR 0088).

PortfolioFeatures.description: Switches of the standards enhancements (ADR 0092). All on except earned value ("optional").

PortfolioOptionsDto.description: Everything the request screens need to render choices and live calculations (labels are configuration).

PortfolioRecordBadge.description: A program request or project as another module may show it (badge), for a caller who may read it.

projectTemplate.description: Q-P2 / Q-P3, ADR 0070: the stage template of projects (Impact switch included).

monthlyDueWorkingDays.description: ADR 0071: working days after the window opens until the monthly update is due.

progressTolerance.description: Q-P6: Delayed when approved progress is more than this below planned-to-date (ratio, 0.05 = 5 points).

gmThreshold.description: Q-P4: change requests with a cost change above this amount go to the GM Office.

agileApprovalMode.description: SPEC §1.13 decision, ADR 0091: `monthly` (default) or `sprint`; a project may override.

teamMembersSeeCosts.description: SPEC §1.9 "View costs / budget — team member: configurable" (ADR 0098). Default off.

teamMembersCreateStories.description: SPEC §1.9 "Create tasks / user stories — team member: configurable". Default off.

capacityThreshold.description: Capacity view: total allocation above this ratio is over-allocation (ADR 0116).

PortfolioSettings.description: Settings → Portfolio (docs/design/portfolio.md §2.1). Defaults are SPEC Appendix A (Q-P5, Q-P6).

PriorityBand.description: A priority band: the highest band whose minimum (ratio, 1.0 = 100 %) is at or below the score applies.

PriorityCriterion.description: A prioritisation criterion (SPEC §1.12 configurable weighted scoring; defaults are the four ADoF criteria).

ProjectCharterValues.description: Charter details the PM edits (SPEC §1.4 B identity, budget & cost, charter resources).

ProjectDeliveryDto.description: Phase 10 additions of the project record: methodology, grouping, re-plan, cost visibility (ADRs 0090, 0094, 0095, 0098).

ProposalDiffEntry.description: One change the PM made to a proposed item before accepting (or an added / removed item).

ProposalItem.description: Plan proposal item (waterfall: phase / milestone with tasks; agile: epic / story). Keys link children to parents inside the proposal.

ProposedChange.description: What a definition change proposes (null = unchanged).

ProtectionRule.description: Term and handling per protection type (ADR 0087): years (null: no expiry), the date the term counts from, internal-only.

ProviderField.description: One setting of a provider type. Labels come from the UI translations (`admin:providers.fields.<key>`).

ProviderTypeSchema.description: Settings form of a provider type: its fields, whether it has a secret, and whether the secret is required.

ReassignEmployeeTasks.description:
"Reassign open tasks of an employee" (ADR 0040). `TaskIds` narrows the preview (null = all open tasks). In `to-creators` mode the
tasks the leaver created themself need `FallbackEmployeeId`, who receives them.

ReassignmentTaskDto.description: One open task of the leaving employee. Titles are left out for tasks the administrator may not read (confidential).

RecentItemDto.description: A recent item (re-resolved on every read).

RecordReferenceDto.description: One reference of a record as the record page shows it (source names resolved).

RecordReferencesDto.description: References of one record; `Origin` is the reference the record was created from (origin badge), if any.

RecordSearchHit.description: A record found by search or similarity, already filtered to what the user may read.

RecordSnapshotDto.description: Field values of a record at a point in time, rebuilt from its create snapshot and later field updates.

RegionalSettings.description: Regional settings (SPEC §0, §0.2 localisation). Hijri display is off by default.

ReleaseNoteDto.description: Release notes of one version in one language (Markdown, shown in the About dialog).

ReportDefinition.description: A report definition as the builder sends it (also stored as a saved report's definition).

ReportFilter.description: One filter. Values are strings in invariant format (dates ISO, numbers with '.', bools true/false).

departmentLevelCode.description: Organisation level whose units are the "departments" of the comparison scorecard; lower units roll up.

fiscalStartMonth.description: First month of the fiscal year (quarters and years).

refreshMinutes.description: Full refresh of the current month every N minutes (dirty systems refresh within about a minute).

attachmentLimitMb.description: Attachments larger than this are sent as a link to the authorised download.

ReportingSettings.description: Settings → Reporting (docs/design/reporting.md §2–§9). Every value is a seeded default the organisation can change.

RequestCapabilities.description: What the current user may do on the request now (drives the record page; the server checks again on every call).

RequestFileDto.description: A file on a request with its kind (`document`, `cost-estimation`, `project-scope`, `quotation`).

unitId.description: Requesting unit (department or section); defaults to the requester's unit.

costPath.description: CostPaths: whether a cost estimation file is available or the project scope goes to Administration.

RequestValues.description:
Every editable value of a Program Request (SPEC §1.4 A, docs/design/portfolio.md §3.1). Used by the wizard (create / update), the rules
and the calculators. Amounts are in the installation currency, two decimals; ratios are 0–1.

RewardCell.description: One cell of the reward matrix: grade × workload × member role → amount.

RiskValues.description: Everything an author sets on a risk (wizard / API / AI draft).

SampleEditorDto.description: An employee holding the item's "editor" record role.

ScaleLevel.description: A level of a qualitative KPI's scale.

green.description: Green from this value (higher is better) or up to it (lower is better).

dashboard.description: Drill target: the system dashboard code.

ScorecardColumn.description: One column of the department comparison scorecard (ADR 0146): a metric with optional dimension filters and RAG limits.

SearchGroupDto.description: The results of one system, best first.

SearchItemDto.description: A found record as the UI shows it: resolved by the Links registry (visible only).

SearchTypeDto.description: A linkable type with its deep-link template (the SPA records record-page visits centrally).

SensitivityRule.description: Who is cleared for a sensitivity level (ADR 0083).

SetupBootstrapInput.description:
First stage of the setup wizard (ADR 0150): organisation profile, branding, languages and the first administrator, in one call
authorised by the one-time setup token.

SetupStatusDto.description: Public state of the first-run setup (ADR 0150). Reveals nothing but whether the wizard is open.

SignInOutcome.description: Outcome of a sign-in step. IReadOnlyList<string> SignInOutcome.Methods lists the second factors the user may use (or enrol).

SimpleStagesInput.description: The simple stage template of custom types (ADR 0080): approval and / or processing.

SmartCheck.description: One check of the SMART quality review of a KPI card (SPEC §2.9 KPI card builder).

SmtpSettingsInput.description: SMTP form. A blank string? SmtpSettingsInput.Password keeps the stored one; bool SmtpSettingsInput.ClearPassword removes it.

SourceSystemInput.description: `Code` is set on create only (it is the stable key in files, URLs and references).

toStage.description: Target stage code; null completes the request (for complete / custom).

StageAction.description: An action of a processing stage, with an optional mini-form.

processKey.description: Approval stages: the engine's process key.

oneOf.description: Approval stages: fields the approver completes before the approval can complete (ADR 0081).

processorRoleKeys.description: Processing stages: role keys whose holders process (empty: the system's office role).

slaHours.description: Processing stages: working hours to act (null: no SLA).

system.description: Built-in stage defined in code (cannot be removed in the builder).

StageDefinition.description: One stage of a request type.

StageTemplate.description: The stage template of a classification (Q-P2 / Q-P3, ADR 0070): which optional steps run. Snapshotted on the project when its lifecycle starts.

SubmitterRule.description: Who may submit a type: everyone, or holders of roles, or members of units (and below).

SuggestionBasis.description: The data behind a suggested level: e.g. 12 of 13 closed = 92.31 %, or 30 h average over 6 meetings.

SystemVersionDto.description: Version of this installation (ADR 0152): product version, source commit when known, build time of the host assembly.

TargetReason.description: A target proposal with the reasons behind it (message keys with parameters).

TaskCapabilitiesDto.description: What the current user may do on the task besides the transitions in IReadOnlyList<string> TaskDto.Actions.

TaskSettings.description: Settings → Tasks (docs/design/tasks.md §2). Defaults are the SPEC / Appendix A build defaults; nothing organisation-specific in code.

TeamListEntry.description: A team in a picker list: identity and status only (no members, never evaluation results).

TeamOptionsDto.description: What the formation wizard and team pages need (any signed-in user): active types and roles, the published template's grades.

TeamSettings.description: Settings → Teams, general area (docs/design/teams.md §2). Types, roles, templates and matrices are tables (ADR 0041).

TemplateContent.description: The content of an evaluation template version (stored as JSON).

Thresholds.description: RAG limits of a tile / gauge (green from / amber from when higher is better, up to otherwise).

TypeInput.description: The form builder's input. Custom types: everything; built-in types: labels, extra fields, catalogue / submitter settings, SLA.

VendorVisibleFields.description: Optional vendor-visible fields (ADR 0113). Costs are off unless switched on here.

WaselSignInOptionsDto.description: Sign-in options the Wasel login page shows (public: says only whether the UAE Pass button is offered).

metrics.description: Bubble: x, y, size metrics, broken down by string? WidgetConfig.Dimension.

WidgetConfig.description:
One widget of a dashboard definition (ADR 0143). Grid: 12 columns, `X` / `Y` / `W` / `H` in grid units.
`Dimension`: breakdown (category axis, table rows, heat-map rows); `Series`: second breakdown (stacks, heat-map columns).
The pseudo-dimension `unit` breaks down by owning unit.

WidgetDataDto.description:
A widget's data for one viewer and period. `State`: `ok`, `unavailable` (the viewer may not see this metric — never 0),
`empty`. Labels resolve dimension codes in both languages.
